Section 2(b)(2) imposes arbitrary age restrictions (68+ in 2028, escalating yearly), denying younger seniors access despite cancer risks. Worse, Section 2(a)(1)(C) lets HHS bureaucrats unilaterally define “appropriate” coverage parameters—a recipe for mission creep.
